findings.title: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) exceeds 4s
findings.description: LCP of 12800ms is extremely poor. Users wait over 12 seconds before the main content becomes visible.
findings.recommendation: The LCP element is a 4MB uncompressed JPEG hero image. Convert to WebP, implement responsive images with srcset, and add preload hints.

findings.title: Total Blocking Time (TBT) exceeds 200ms
findings.description: TBT of 2400ms means the page is completely unresponsive for over 2 seconds during load.
findings.recommendation: Main thread breakdown: Script evaluation (1800ms), Style calculation (400ms), Layout (200ms). Defer non-critical scripts and eliminate render-blocking JavaScript.

findings.title: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) exceeds 0.1
findings.description: CLS of 0.45 causes significant visual instability. Elements shift positions during page load, leading to accidental clicks.
findings.recommendation: Set explicit width/height on images and embeds, use CSS aspect-ratio, and inject ad placeholders before ads load.

findings.title: Server response time (TTFB) exceeds 600ms
findings.description: TTFB of 2800ms indicates the server takes nearly 3 seconds to begin sending data. This delays all subsequent processing.
findings.recommendation: Server runs on shared hosting with no caching. Implement Redis caching, optimize database queries, and consider a CDN.

findings.title: Eliminate render-blocking resources
findings.description: 8 stylesheets and 6 scripts block page rendering, adding over 4 seconds to the initial paint.
findings.recommendation: Inline critical CSS, defer non-critical resources, and load third-party scripts asynchronously.

findings.title: Unused CSS rules
findings.description: 5 stylesheets contain over 200KB of unused CSS selectors.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused CSS or use critical CSS inlining. Consider PurgeCSS for automated dead code elimination.

findings.title: Missing document language
findings.description: The <html> element does not have a lang attribute, making it impossible for screen readers to determine the correct pronunciation.
findings.recommendation: Add lang='en' (or appropriate language code) to the <html> element.

findings.title: Form elements do not have associated labels
findings.description: 7 form inputs lack labels, making them unusable for screen reader users and difficult for all users to understand.
findings.recommendation: Associate each form input with a <label> element using the for attribute or by wrapping the input in the label.

findings.title: Image elements do not have [alt] attributes
findings.description: 23 images are missing alt attributes entirely, making them invisible to screen readers.
findings.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text to all informational images. Use alt='' for decorative images.

findings.title: Elements with ARIA roles do not have required ARIA attributes
findings.description: 5 interactive elements with ARIA roles are missing required attributes (aria-expanded, aria-controls).
findings.recommendation: Add required ARIA attributes to all elements with explicit roles.

findings.title: Document does not have a meta description
findings.description: No meta description is provided, causing search engines to auto-generate snippets from page content.
findings.recommendation: Add unique meta descriptions to all pages.

findings.title: Page does not have a valid hreflang
findings.description: The site declares hreflang tags for 3 languages but the return links are missing or incorrect.
findings.recommendation: Ensure all hreflang links are bidirectional and point to valid URLs.

findings.title: Document does not have a valid rel=canonical
findings.description: No canonical tag is specified, risking duplicate content issues across URL variations.
findings.recommendation: Add a rel=canonical tag pointing to the preferred URL for each page.

findings.title: Uses HTTP/1.1 for some resources
findings.description: 18 resources are served over HTTP/1.1 instead of HTTP/2, preventing multiplexing and header compression.
findings.recommendation: Enable HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 on the server. Most modern servers support HTTP/2 with minimal configuration.

findings.title: Browser errors logged to the console
findings.description: 8 JavaScript errors are logged to the browser console, indicating broken functionality.
findings.recommendation: Fix all console errors. Implement error monitoring with Sentry or similar.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
findings.description: The X-Content-Type-Options header is not set, allowing browsers to MIME-sniff responses.
findings.recommendation: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header to all responses.

findings.title: Mixed content detected
findings.description: Page loads 5 resources over HTTP while served over HTTPS. Browsers may block these resources.
findings.recommendation: Update all resource URLs to HTTPS. Use protocol-relative URLs if needed for development environments.

findings.title: CSP header is missing
findings.description: No Content-Security-Policy header is set, leaving the site vulnerable to XSS and data injection attacks.

opportunities.title: Properly size images
opportunities.description: Images are larger than their display dimensions. Serving appropriately sized images can reduce load time.

opportunities.title: Serve images in next-gen formats
opportunities.description: PNG and JPEG images can be converted to WebP or AVIF for 30-50% size reduction.

opportunities.title: Enable text compression
opportunities.description: Text resources are served uncompressed, adding unnecessary transfer size.

opportunities.title: Reduce unused JavaScript
opportunities.description: 4 JavaScript bundles contain over 500KB of unused code.

opportunities.title: Defer offscreen images
opportunities.description: 12 images below the fold load eagerly, blocking more critical resources.

opportunities.title: Reduce the impact of third-party code
opportunities.description: Third-party scripts block the main thread for 1.2 seconds and transfer 1.8MB.
